comments.author: Bryan1
comments.body: Price check on this ship? I see some troll offering 2b, another offering a crappy ETraC + some other garbage.. This ship seems like it should be worth a little more than what those goldseller trolls are offering. Any real players know?

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: There are no truly fixed prices for any item in this game; I purchased a 1/5 Custom Long Merchant Schooner for 150m in a player bazaar, and those typically sell for 2 to 2.5b ducats according to "public opinion". And it wasn't a bad build, either. Whatever answers you may ultimately get, don't be surprised to find buyers offering more or less than the suggested asking price.

comments.author: Tester
comments.body:
As it is worse than ANL (available at ~1.7b in ticket)in most stats and in skillset pricechecks ingame usually tend to be between 1.5b to 1.7b ..maybe 2b tops. The offers Bryan1 mentioned in his post seem rather realistic. Wouldnt assume thse were offers by "goldseller trolls" - specially as golldsellers sell gold, not buy ships lol. Savvia times are over :D.

All discussions in merch chat about that one confirmed it as nice aide battle ship, but nothing that is worth more than 2b tops for sure.

comments.author: Yes
comments.body: 1400 dura at G3 though, which is better than ANL in this regard.

comments.author: SBer
comments.body: Correct, but the higher dura and crew are the only aspects at all that even bring this ship into ANLs price range. Else it wouldnt even be worth 1.5 to 2b probably as there are many good battle ships on market in similar price range. Even ModSupFrigate is better in most stats and also available around 1.5b ticket. As someone mentioned above, Modified Applet is basically an aide ship. It's understandable that someone who won one in bottle lottery may try to highball it, but for players who can do the maths about stats it is probably maximally in price range of ANL or ModSupFrigate tickets.

comments.author: clown
comments.body: 1400+ Dura is very important.. High max dura is a key factor, its why a great ship like AV with 10 mods and 225 sailors isn't worth all youd think with a 1340ish max dura but a piece of crap high level HSFCV 6 mod ship with only 157 sailors but 1440+ dura is worth as much as it is.. It means the difference of surviving crits or not... There are only a handful of ships over 1400 Dura able to survive just about any crit now without god guns around.
